TreeletHub lets you arrange favorite Mac apps in a grid on the Mac, then open TreeletHub on your phone—on the same Wi‑Fi—to launch those apps remotely. Reorder slots with drag and drop on either side.
Keep TreeletHub running on the desk Mac. From the couch or another room, use your phone as a remote launcher for apps you already placed in the hub.

1) On the Mac, open TreeletHub and read the six-digit pairing code.\n2) On this phone, open Connect to Mac, type the code, then tap Connect.\n3) If discovery fails, check Wi‑Fi, turn off VPN, and stay on the same network as the Mac.

1) Tap any cell and choose a Mac app (.app) to assign.
2) Drag tiles to swap or move apps between cells.
3) Extra tabs (Apps1, …) add more pages; some tabs require an active subscription.
4) If you regenerate the pairing code on the Mac, each phone must reconnect with the new code.
Use the Apps tab for the live grid. In Settings, rename how your phone appears on the Mac, change the backdrop, or swap your one saved photo background.
